execution: Sequential complete route runs, then sequential repeat/device/version pairs within each route. No concurrent performance audits. Same original immutable deployments as the Seedance comparison.
reviewRule: Retain every valid sample and every unfavourable result. Inspect each route/device/temperature separately. A slower LCP median or repeated paired deterioration prompts investigation; do not infer field non-regression from a small sample. A reproducible regression blocks production readiness.
lcpRule: Measure the actual LCP element; do not require it to be the poster. Independently assert that the canonical watch reader and all three quotes are rendered.
